description: MCP interface for the Microservices topology. Provides tools for inspecting and validating microservice configurations, resources for manifest and ruleset access, and prompts for microservice-governed implementation and extraction-readiness guidance.

tools.name: evolith-topology-inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Microservices topology configuration and return its parsed manifest, service topology, and corpus artifact references.

configPath.description: Path to the Microservices configuration file

includeServices.description: Include service boundary, communication, and discovery metadata

tools.name: evolith-topology-validate
tools.description: Validate a Microservices configuration against the topology ruleset and OPA policies, returning pass/fail per gate.

configPath.description: Path to the Microservices configuration to validate

strictMode.description: Fail on warnings, not just errors

resources.name: Microservices Topology Manifest
resources.description: Full topology manifest for Microservices, including metadata, artifact references, and corpus configuration.

resources.name: Microservices Rulesets
resources.description: All ruleset files for Microservices: native rules JSON, OPA Rego policies, and WASM bundle.

prompts.name: topology-aware-implementation
prompts.description: Guides AI-assisted implementation to respect Microservices topology constraints, service autonomy, and API contract governance.

prompts.name: extraction-readiness-review
prompts.description: Evaluates whether a module is ready for extraction into an independent microservice, checking coupling, ownership, and contract boundaries.
